problem.text: ComboSampler previously sent zero temperature through ordinary scaling and categorical sampling. SS_Temperature divides logits by temperature or computes its reciprocal for probabilities; neither implements an explicit greedy policy.

reasoning.text: The patch branches after constructing the history-penalty stages: exactly zero temperature appends SS_Argmax; all other temperatures retain the existing filter-and-sample sequence.

impact.text: Zero-temperature selection remains penalty-aware but ignores min_p, top_k, top_p and temp_last. The chat example passes its temperature argument directly to ComboSampler.

source_notes.text: The earlier ComboSampler entry records the incompatible min_p=0 default. This change bypasses that construction only at zero temperature.

PR #22, “OpenAI compatible API example,” proposes an API endpoint and contains discussion code constructing ComboSampler. Its relevance is inferred from that shared constructor, not evidence that it motivated this fix.

limitations: No repository sampler, PyTorch operation or CUDA kernel was executed. The scalar check verifies branch predicates and Python reciprocal behavior, not generated tokens or tensor division-by-zero behavior.
Whole-tree literal search establishes the chat constructor and package export; dynamic or external callers are not exhaustively covered.

chapters.title: Penalty-aware greedy sampling at zero temperature

claims.text: The zero-temperature path contains repetition penalties, presence/frequency penalties and argmax. Neutral penalties become no-ops; active penalties produce unsorted LOGITS. SS_Argmax handles both INIT and LOGITS by selecting along the vocabulary dimension and setting DONE, so this path does not require sorting, normalization or Gumbel noise.

CustomSampler.forward still applies vocabulary and allowed/blocked-token masks before the steps and reshapes the selected token to the input's non-vocabulary dimensions. Greedy therefore means the maximum of the eligible, penalty-adjusted logits, not necessarily the original model maximum.

Zero is an exact dispatch sentinel, not an epsilon threshold. A scalar transcription selected argmax for both signed zeros, but retained filtering for 1e-9, 0.8 and 1.0. It also demonstrated that the existing probability-scaling expression 1.0/0.0 raises ZeroDivisionError.

For nonzero temperature the order remains penalties, optional early temperature, min-p, top-k, top-p, optional late temperature and categorical sampling. Temperature 1.0 becomes a no-op. Existing CategoricalSampler and TopKSampler already use explicit zero-temperature argmax branches; reusing that policy avoids approximating greedy selection with a very small positive temperature.

findings.description: The inherited default min-p construction failure persists for nonzero temperature; the new branch removes it only for zero temperature.
findings.trigger: Construct ComboSampler() or otherwise use nonzero temperature with min_p=0 while assertions are enabled.
findings.expected_behavior: Neutral min-p settings permit construction without filtering.
findings.actual_behavior: The nonzero branch constructs SS_MinP(0.0), whose constructor asserts 0.0 < min_p <= 1.0. The whole-parent-tree search found one direct construction site in examples/chat.py: it explicitly supplies min_p, defaults to 0.08, and exposes a zero value through its CLI. Default chat settings therefore avoid this trigger.

verification.description: Compared the retained nonzero branch and default against the step assertion and inspected the direct chat caller.
Evaluated the branch and min-p assertion predicates for signed zero and representative nonzero temperatures.

annotation.summary: Makes ComboSampler use penalty-aware argmax at exactly zero temperature, bypassing filters and stochastic sampling while retaining the nonzero path.
